name: Develin

facts.text: Level 60. Develin appears only at night, and only after 20 to 40 pookas have been slain in the Cursed Forest; until then he cannot be seen.
His pookas come to his aid when he is fought.
Irish folklore (not game canon): the púca is a shape-changing spirit.

story: Develin is the master of the pookas of the Cursed Forest, and like any master he does not show himself until his servants have been badly treated. Kill one pooka and nothing happens. Kill twenty, thirty, forty, and some night there is a new figure among the trees, watching. He has a name like a Hibernian's, which the Ardee folk find worse than if he had none: they say he was a man once who made a bargain with the pookas and got the better of it, and has regretted it ever since. His pookas still come when he calls.
legend: You have to earn him: kill pookas at night until he appears, somewhere between twenty and forty. Then his pookas come to his side, so clear them as they come. A small band can do it if they are patient.

aggro: You have been killing my little ones.
slay: My pookas will play with your bones.

lairEntry: Small shapes run between the trees, laughing.

phases.text: Develin's pookas swarm to his side!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Develin's bargain is broken. The pookas scatter.
